In CNIL’s practical AI guidance sheets, age information should be handled by prioritizing the least intrusive format without losing relevant information for the intended objective. For example, instead of using a complete date of birth, it is recommended to use a broader category such as age or age range.

In the context of a diagnosis-aid system, an example provided suggests that generalizing age information to formats like [month-year] or [year] instead of [day-month-year] can significantly reduce the risk of loss of confidentiality while still maintaining the system's ability to generalize effectively.
